name: structure-viewer
description: Read-only atomic structure and trajectory viewer with element visibility, group styles, ordered measurements and snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: 原子结构与轨迹查看、选择与测量
interface.longDescription: View XYZ, extxyz, ASE traj and VASP structures. Includes element visibility, box selection, per-selection styles, distances, angles, dihedrals, atom following and snapshots. Bare VASP names can be opened with the local Open button; native file links require suffixes.
